subject: An invitation for Kinapod to take over one page
text:
Hi Kinapod team,

I saw how Kinapod uses an AirPod in a disc to measure spin and throw angles. Turning hardware people already have into a sports sensor is a distinctive project to show in one sentence.

I built Take The Wall: one public page with one featured owner. Would you be interested in trying it with Kinapod? Your project replaces the current content and stays until somebody else takes over.

Browsing and previewing are free; publishing costs $3.99. This is an early experiment, with no guaranteed audience or duration.

https://takethewall.com/?utm_source=personal&utm_medium=outreach&utm_campaign=first_owners&utm_content=kinapod

No need to reply if it’s not for you; I won’t send follow-up reminders.

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
